record.summary: The (i,i,j) slices of the third cumulant feed the pair map. Card and full engine are both ~7% accurate on this plane (closure_rel 0.083-0.089; engine rel 0.066-0.14); the engine's value comes from differently structured errors (dK21 corr 0.77 to truth-host). The carried content that matters is order-2 path words = the card's own CP3 births (DTOT=2 +9.8 ~ DTOT=6 +10.3) - the tensor is NOT the mechanism (wall retracted, T-19). Windows at optimal beta: L1-4 +1.8, L5-8 ~0, L9-11 +7.1, L12-14 +1.9 (T-19b). Children: emission formula, push/read, carry accuracy, fourth-order inputs, univariate inputs, integration scale. HONEST FRAME (T-36, independent 4M truth, r35, F2J-on, deployed 2.704e-8, +-3 points): truth K21 alone 7.1; truth K21+K22+K31 24.4 (consumer beyond linearization null: 23.1). Engine supply 8.5 v / 14.7 k3 / joint 25.7-26.4 at BV 0.4, BK3 0.33-0.5.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when a deployable plane chain reproduces the engine's supply value on the panel at acceptable bill.

evidence.claim: optimal-beta sweeps; window supplies; engine diag.

record.goal_path_summary: The single biggest fixable input: a per-layer table of how each pair of neurons' third-order statistics shift the variances. The expensive part of computing it is something the estimator already does; the missing part is a cheap final formula, mostly at layers 9-11.
